title: The Family Tradition Redesigned
short_teaser: Traditions can be adapted to new ages, locations, abilities, or family structures without losing their meaning.
story: Traditions can be adapted to new ages, locations, abilities, or family structures without losing their meaning. Continuity can include thoughtful change. Creativity grows through attention, experimentation, revision, and the courage to make an imperfect beginning. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Continuity can include thoughtful change. Creativity grows through attention, experimentation, revision, and the courage to make an imperfect beginning.
